$NU: Nubank Buys Banco Porto Real to Secure a Brazilian Banking License

Deal Purpose

•	$NU agreed to acquire Banco Porto Real de Investimentos, pending Brazilian Central Bank approval.

•	The acquisition lets Nubank comply with Joint Resolution No. 17.

•	Banco Porto Real’s banking license will join Nubank’s existing regulatory licenses.

Financial Impact

•	Nubank says the deal requires no additional capital or liquidity.

Brazil Expansion

•	Nubank committed R$45 billion of Brazil investment for 2026.

•	Nubank says 31.5 million Brazilians gained financial access through its platform.

•	The award supports Project Solar Shield, a national-security program protecting critical U.S. assets and infrastructure.

•	Kratos begins work immediately at secure company facilities.

What Kratos Delivers

•	Kratos will provide mobile Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System platforms.

•	The systems will detect, track, identify, and respond to hostile drones.

•	The platform combines layered drone defense, mobile design, command-and-control, and resilient power management.

Why It Matters

•	Kratos calls Solar Shield the first large-scale government production contract using this integrated mobile C-UAS approach.

$OSS received a $2.2 million production order from an autonomous construction and mining-equipment manufacturer.

•	The order follows successful prototype delivery, testing, and validation.

•	Deliveries are scheduled from Q3 2026 through Q3 2027.

What OSS Supplies

•	OSS will provide Gen5 ruggedized, liquid-cooled 3U short-depth servers.

•	The systems will support commercial autonomous heavy-equipment operations in demanding mobile environments.

•	The customer selected OSS to replace its incumbent compute provider.

Growth Potential

•	OSS expects cumulative program orders of $10 million to $15 million over five years.

•	The production win expands OSS beyond its core defense and aerospace markets.

TSMC Plans 5%–10% Chip Price Increases From 2027 as Costs Rise

Pricing Changes

•	TSMC plans to raise chipmaking prices by 5% to 10%, depending on the customer and product.

•	The new pricing is expected to begin in early 2027 after negotiations that reportedly started in June and concluded in July.

•	TSMC did not confirm specific pricing changes, saying its strategy is “strategic, not opportunistic.”

Most Affected Chips

•	Mature-node production—12 nm, 16 nm, and 28 nm—could face increases of up to 10%.

•	TSMC is seeking to offset rising costs for materials, manufacturing equipment, and overseas fab construction.

Demand Backdrop

•	CEO C.C. Wei said in June that TSMC wanted to raise prices but would avoid abrupt increases like those imposed by some memory suppliers.

Novo Nordisk Sues Eli Lilly Over Ads Claiming Zepbound, Mounjaro Outperform Wegovy, Ozempic

Lawsuit Claim

•	Novo Nordisk sued Eli Lilly in U.S. District Court in New Jersey, alleging false advertising and unfair competition.

•	Novo says Lilly’s nationwide ads falsely portray Zepbound and Mounjaro as superior to Wegovy and Ozempic.

•	The lawsuit alleges violations of the federal Lanham Act and state law.

Dose Comparison Dispute

•	Novo says Lilly compared its highest approved doses with lower doses of Wegovy and Ozempic.

•	Novo says the ads omitted newer, higher-dose versions of its drugs that it says produce greater weight loss.

•	Novo is challenging the ads—not seeking to block Lilly from selling Zepbound or Mounjaro.

NASA’s $2.1B Nuclear Mars Mission Targets Late-2028 Launch; Could Validate New Deep-Space Propulsion

Mission Cost

•	NASA estimates Space Reactor-1 Freedom will cost about $2.1 billion, excluding the Skyfall science payload.

•	The funding plan requests $640 million in 2026, $890 million in 2027, $415 million in 2028, and $180 million in 2029.

•	NASA says the estimate remains preliminary and will be refined during procurement.

What It Tests

•	NASA targets a December 2028 launch for the first fission nuclear-powered spacecraft intended for interplanetary propulsion.

•	SR-1 Freedom will test nuclear-electric propulsion in flight by using a reactor to generate electricity for its thrusters.

•	NASA sees the mission as a pathfinder for future lunar, Mars, and outer-solar-system power and propulsion systems.

Morgan Stanley Says AI Could Lift Mortgage Refinancing Volumes

AI could add hundreds of billions in refinancing volume by cutting friction across the mortgage process. The biggest effects are likely in refinancing, loan pricing, and home-equity extraction.

Refinancing Impact

•	AI could make refinancing easier, faster, and more targeted.

•	Morgan Stanley says that could turn the 30-year fixed mortgage into something closer to a “floater that only floats down.”

•	That would strengthen the lock-in effect when rates rise, because homeowners would be less likely to move.

Market Effects

•	Better AI-driven product matching could improve affordability and access to credit.

•	The bank expects higher mortgage sales volumes and potentially higher homeownership.

$RDW Redwire opened a 30,000-square-foot microgravity R&D facility in Indiana to expand space-enabled research and manufacturing. The site is meant to support pharma, biotech, and other microgravity applications.

Facility Focus

•	Includes advanced labs and a Payload Operations Control Center.

•	Will oversee ISS science and research operations in real time.

•	Also serves as a key SpaceMD operations site.

Mobileye $MBLY says Stellantis will add its REM-based cloud-enhanced ADAS to select 2027 vehicles, starting with some U.S. models. The system is designed to improve hands-free driving, lane keeping, and road-intelligence updates.

Key Details

•	REM uses crowdsourced vehicle data to update road maps and driving intelligence continuously.

•	Mobileye says REM covers more than 95% of public roads in the U.S. and Europe.

•	Five of the world’s 10 largest automakers contribute data to REM.

•	REM has drawn data from more than 8 million vehicles and 34 billion miles of driving last year.

Why It Matters

•	The deal expands Mobileye’s cloud-connected ADAS footprint with a major global automaker.

•	It also supports Mobileye’s broader push from assisted driving toward more automated systems.

Unity $U announced Unity 7, its next-generation game development platform, with early beta due in December and full release in Q1 2027. The update is built to work with existing Unity 6 projects without rebuilding.

What’s New

•	Unity 7 is designed for collaboration between creators and coding agents.

•	It integrates with existing AI tools across the development workflow.

•	New CLI, public API, and free MCP support are meant to simplify agent integration.

•	Play Mode and shader builds are faster, with shader builds up to 90% quicker.

Graphics And Monetization

•	New graphics features include Surface Cache GI and AI optimization.

•	Unity Vector is aimed at improving player acquisition and monetization.
